members.role: Initiator, Backend Developer, Astronomy Content Editor
members.bioEn:
I am an aspiring astrophysicist. I investigate physical systems through computational modelling, statistical inference and large-scale data analysis, and I want to contribute to observational and computational research on astronomical datasets.

I care about open science and the democratisation of research, so I advocate for accessible scientific data infrastructure, transparent methods and collaborative knowledge-sharing. I also do human rights advocacy, focused on gender equity, LGBTQ+ rights and racial justice.

Alongside this, I work in information architecture. I regularly collect, cross-reference and reconcile disparate qualitative sources into one coherent system, which has sharpened my pattern recognition, systematic literature review and technical documentation.
